## Big idea

Real systems split into services, pass messages (Kafka), cache (Redis), and deploy as units.

```text
API service → Kafka → worker service
     │
     └→ Redis cache
```

## Practice focus

Follow the video’s project structure. Map each piece: which service owns which data? What is sync HTTP vs async messaging?

## Reasoning

Microservices add network failure modes. Start modular monolith unless you need independent scaling.
